attributes.description: Time-based view of Zeek network events used to identify baseline behavior, spikes, and abnormal traffic patterns.
attributes.title: Zeek – Network Activity Over Time

attributes.description: Distribution of network protocols observed by Zeek, used to identify dominant traffic patterns and detect abnormal protocol usage in a SOC environment.
attributes.title: Network Protocol Distribution

attributes.description: Displays the top source IP addresses generating Zeek network events, helping identify noisy hosts, scanning activity, and potential compromised endpoints in a SOC environment.
attributes.title: Top Source IPs (Network Talkers)

attributes.description: Displays the most frequently contacted destination IP addresses observed by Zeek, enabling identification of external communication patterns and supporting threat hunting and incident investigation in a SOC environment.
attributes.title: Top Destination IPs

attributes.description: Shows time-based trends of rejected TCP connections observed by Zeek, enabling analysts to detect port scanning, unauthorized access attempts, and abnormal connection behavior during network monitoring and threat hunting.
attributes.title: Rejected Connections Over Time

attributes.description: Displays correlated port scan activity detected by Zeek over time. This visualization highlights repeated rejected connection patterns indicative of network reconnaissance and scanning behavior, enabling SOC analysts to track attacker activity, identify scanning bursts, and assess threat persistence within the monitored environment.
attributes.title: Port Scan Activity Over Time

attributes.description: Displays endpoints and destinations involved in SSL/TLS connections with invalid certificates, including self-signed and expired certificates. This visualization helps SOC analysts identify insecure encryption practices, misconfigured applications, and potential malicious communication.
attributes.title: SSL/TLS Certificate Issues

attributes.description: Provides a detailed, analyst-level view of raw Zeek network events, including source and destination IPs, destination ports, protocols, and detection context. This table enables SOC analysts to quickly pivot from high-level detections into granular network activity for investigation, validation, and incident response without switching to raw logs.
attributes.title: Raw Network Events

attributes.description: This dashboard provides comprehensive network visibility using Zeek network security monitoring data integrated with Wazuh. It enables SOC analysts to monitor overall network activity, analyze protocol usage, identify top network talkers, detect rejected connections and port scanning behavior, assess SSL/TLS certificate issues, and perform detailed event-level investigations. The dashboard supports both real-time monitoring and threat hunting workflows in a SOC environment.
attributes.title: Zeek – Network Security Monitoring & Threat Hunting
